Every venue on Rumizi has two brand images: a **logo** that appears in
your menu header and a **hero image** used on the public
[restaurants directory](https://rumizi.com/restaurants) card. Both are
optional but strongly recommended — a menu without them looks generic.

## Where to set them

In your workspace, go to **Settings → Brand**. You'll see two upload
slots — one for the logo, one for the hero image.

## What each one is for

<Columns cols={2}>
  <Card title="Logo" icon="stamp">
    A small mark shown in the menu header, on your workspace, and on
    your restaurants-directory card. Square or wide, transparent
    background works best.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Hero image" icon="gallery-horizontal">
    The full-width photo on your restaurants-directory card. Pick
    something appetising and identifiable — the room, a signature dish,
    the front of the venue.
  </Card>
</Columns>

<Note>
The public menu itself is menu-first — no landing page, no scrollable
intro section. Diners who scan the QR code land straight on the menu.
The hero image and logo do the "first impression" job on the directory
page instead.
</Note>

## Uploading

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the Brand tab">
    In your workspace, go to **Settings → Brand**.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pick or generate">
    Upload from your device, pick from the
    [gallery](/vendors/media/gallery), or generate one with AI.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Save">
    Changes take effect on the next page load. No publish flow — brand
    images update immediately.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## AI helpers

If you don't have art to hand:

- **Generate logo** — creates a simple mark from your venue name.
- **Generate hero image** — creates a banner from your venue details.
- **Improve hero image** — cleans up an existing photo you uploaded.

All AI output is editable and you can regenerate as many times as you
want.
